about: settings-min-text: committed renames of line-baseline state keys in the committed fixture settings-min-text.lines.json (a supplement is recorded under the new keys and is not renamed). A baseline state that finds no head state fails unless this file renames it or lists it under retired. Prefix renames only: rows are never edited. Each rule replaces a leading "from" with its "to" and applies, in order, to the key the rules before it produced. Retired states are named by their original fixture key.
